# Which fee model actually pays you the most per hour on this design project?

> Compare hourly, flat, percent-of-cost, per-square-foot and hybrid interior design fees: effective hourly, break-even overrun and walk-away fee. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
